dedupe_keys.name: reproducibility package for reconfiguration robust spatiotemporal learning for dynamic ev hosting capacity estimation in distribution feeders

description: University of Alberta researchers publish processed data and trained checkpoints for dynamic electric-vehicle hosting-capacity estimation. Zenodo supplies two archives and detailed text dictionaries free under CC BY 4.0 for original project outputs. The documented layout covers a base feeder and five switching scenarios, hourly OpenDSS results, graph tensors, bus-level capacity labels and evaluation artefacts. These files can benchmark surrogate predictions in distribution-network charging simulations. Related catalogue data-iowa-distribution-test-systems supplies the original feeder and load assets, which retain their own terms; G6 model-reconfiguration-robust-dynamic-evhc covers the software. Coverage is a study-specific feeder configuration, not a universal operating limit. Limitations include several dictionary fields that describe expected, not independently checked contents, and the full pipeline needs Windows and OpenDSS COM. No archive was downloaded, checkpoint evaluated or safety margin verified.
